# DearAgent

> Self-hosted email inboxes for AI agents on Cloudflare Workers. Receive, read, reply, send, webhooks, MCP.

DearAgent gives every AI agent its own email inbox, running entirely on the user's Cloudflare account. One Worker, one repo, no servers.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): overview, quick start, and API reference.
- [Agent skill](skills/dearagent/SKILL.md): instructions for agents using DearAgent.
